domain_specific_rationale: From a platform engineering, tooling, and infrastructure automation standpoint, downstream consumers and automated build agents must be provided with a zero-dependency, self-contained verification tool to deterministically validate package integrity. Prior release processes relied on ad-hoc scripts or unverified manifest states (GOV-006 / TECH-011). CP-024 introduces `verify_package.py` into the root of the specification package. The tool utilizes exclusively Python 3 standard library modules (os, sys, hashlib, json) to traverse the package directory, exclude self-referential manifest and hash files, sort file paths in deterministic lexicographical order, compute individual file SHA-256 digests, and calculate the canonical CONTENT_TREE_SHA256 digest. This provides a universally runnable, deterministic verification gate for CI/CD runners and external auditors.
evidence_citations: REVISED_SPEC_CANDIDATE/verify_package.py:L1-L40 (Complete zero-dependency standalone verification script with deterministic tree hashing and explicit exclusion sets)
REVISED_SPEC_CANDIDATE/README.md:L23-L25 (Documented execution instructions for independent package verification)
REMEDIATION_FINDING_REGISTER.md:L247-L263 (Closure criteria for TECH-011 and GOV-006)
capability_impact: Provides automated, verifiable, tamper-evident package validation across all deployment targets and platforms without external package dependencies.
residual_risk: Operating system file permission differences or filesystem-specific extended attributes (.DS_Store) inadvertently modifying tree hash outputs. Mitigated by explicit EXCLUDE_FILES filtering and dotfile omission logic in verify_package.py.
